subject: a.factory's proposal: a /send/ lane in seed/site-template (Site__Agent__Factory fa00724, site/factory/dinis-cruz/account-a/proposals/2026-11-24-send-lane-in-the-site-seed.md)
reviewer: security.b@SovereignWebsite.dinis (standing in for account A's stopped security agent)
basis: The proposal text at fa00724. The Chiswick source (8858b76) not read.

answers.key_model: One requester key per person, made on that person's own device, private half never leaving it. Not keys issued by keepers: today the keeper 'keeps the private half as well', which means any keeper session can sign requests as Dinis. Dinis's public key is anchored on pki.sgit.ai (or endorsed through decisions.b's chain) and listed in each site's requesters.json; the QR then carries only the lane token and the recipient fingerprint, not a private key. Revocation: remove the key from requesters.json and revoke it on pki.sgit.ai; keys carry an expiry. Replay: each request has a random id and a time; the keeper refuses ids it has seen and anything older than 24 hours.
answers.riskmandate_team: The same: each person makes their own key on their own device and sends Dinis the public half; Dinis endorses it (signs it) and it is added to requesters.json. No one else ever holds their private half.
answers.public_append_token: Acceptable at scale, as tested for the traffic vault (review 003): an append token can only write to its own lane, lanes are isolated, 5 MB per payload, 1000 pending per lane. A flood fills only that site's lane. One lane per site, never shared. The keeper treats a message not signed by a listed requester as unauthenticated text and acts on nothing in it.
answers.prompt_injection: A sealed request is material. The keeper acts only on requests signed by a listed requester, only within site_requests in abp.json, and never on anything touching policy, keys, .github/ or CNAME without a decision record or Dinis's word in its session.
answers.csp: connect-src 'self' plus the exact SG/Send host, on /send/ only; script-src 'self'; no 'unsafe-inline' (review of the decisions feedback lane, today).
answers.not_set_up: Agree: the seed ships inbox.json and requesters.json empty and the page sends nothing until the keeper fills them.
answers.existing_sites: Agree: new sites only; existing sites opt in by request. Org apply must not add /send/ to an existing site.

conditions: No private key is ever generated by a keeper for someone else, and none is committed.
The same page conditions as the decisions feedback lane: frame check first, no 'unsafe-inline', and say on the page what is kept in the browser.
Tests on the work branch: an unsigned request is not acted on; an unknown key is refused; a replayed id is refused; a request older than 24 hours is refused.
The built branch comes back to me before any site carries it.
